source_evidence: Each ETF share represents an investor’s part ownership of the ETF’s portfolio and the income the portfolio generates.
answer: An exchange-traded fund (ETF) pools money from many investors to invest in a portfolio of assets, such as stocks or bonds. Owning an ETF share means owning a part of that portfolio and its income. ETF shares are bought and sold on stock exchanges at market prices, which may differ from the ETF’s net asset value (NAV).
